name: Matsugami Haruto
source: The protagonist. At the beginning of the story he saves [url=/c10367]Ayano[/url] from a car accident and end up getting hospitalized. Doesn't like lying or flattering people nor does he care much about his own appearance. An extremely selfless person, he would not hesitate to risk his own life to safe others. Values his family greatly, especially his [url=/c10455]sister[/url] who he loves doting on.
